title: Co-Lending and Portfolio File Audit
summary: Check every loan file in a co-lending tranche, assignment pool or portfolio buyout against eligibility criteria and the loan system, listing missing documents and mismatches before money moves.

seo.title: Co-Lending and Portfolio Loan File Audit with AI | VipraTech
seo.description: AI that audits co-lending and portfolio loan files against eligibility criteria, LMS data and checklists, and lists missing documents and mismatches.

designed_for: Credit Risk Manager at a partner bank

problem.intro: When a bank takes its share of co-lent loans, buys a pool through direct assignment or invests in a securitised pool, someone has to check that each loan file matches the agreed criteria and the data tape. Sampling a few files leaves the rest unchecked, while reviewing every file by hand takes weeks that the transaction timeline rarely allows.

pain_points.title: Data tape and files disagree
pain_points.detail: Loan amount, tenure, rate, borrower details or sanction date in the tape do not always match the sanction letter, loan agreement or LMS.

pain_points.title: Missing or defective documents
pain_points.detail: Unsigned agreements, missing Key Fact Statements, absent NACH mandates or outdated KYC appear in some files and are found late.

pain_points.title: Eligibility criteria applied by hand
pain_points.detail: Each partnership agreement sets its own criteria on bureau score, LTV, FOIR, geography and product, which reviewers check file by file.

pain_points.title: Evidence partners can rely on
pain_points.detail: Partner banks and investors increasingly want a file-level record of what was checked, not a summary certificate.

solution.overview: We build a file audit pipeline for co-lending and portfolio transactions. It ingests the data tape, the LMS extract and the scanned loan files, classifies each document and extracts the fields that matter: borrower identity, sanction terms, agreement terms, KFS details, mandate, insurance and collateral. It then reconciles three ways, tape against LMS against documents, applies the eligibility criteria in the partnership or assignment agreement, and runs your file completeness checklist. Each loan receives a status with exceptions that cite the document and page. Uncertain extractions and borderline criteria go to a reviewer, and the result is a pool-level exception report plus a file-level evidence trail.
capabilities: Ingests data tapes, LMS extracts and scanned loan files at pool scale
Extracts sanction, agreement, KFS, mandate, insurance and collateral details
Three-way reconciliation of tape, loan system and documents with tolerance rules
Eligibility criteria from co-lending or assignment agreements encoded as reviewable rules
File completeness checks for KYC, signatures, dates and mandatory disclosures
Pool-level exception report and per-loan evidence trail for partners and auditors

workflow.title: Load the pool
workflow.detail: The data tape, LMS extract and loan files for the pool are loaded and matched by loan account number.

workflow.title: Classify and extract
workflow.detail: Each file's documents are classified and key terms extracted with confidence and page references.

workflow.title: Reconcile three ways
workflow.detail: Tape, LMS and document values are compared field by field within agreed tolerances.

workflow.title: Apply criteria and checklist
workflow.detail: Eligibility rules and the completeness checklist run on each loan, producing pass, fail or review.

workflow.title: Reviewer decisions
workflow.detail: Reviewers clear uncertain items and confirm exceptions, which the originator can then cure or exclude.

workflow.title: Report the pool
workflow.detail: A pool-level exception report and per-loan evidence pack go to the partner, investor or audit committee.

inputs: LMS extract for the loans in scope
Scanned loan files: application, KYC, sanction letter, loan agreement, KFS
NACH or e-mandate registrations and insurance documents
Co-lending or assignment agreement with eligibility criteria
outputs: Per-loan status with exceptions and source references
Eligibility and checklist results per loan
Evidence pack for partner, investor or auditor review
human_in_the_loop: Reviewers confirm every exception and clear uncertain items, and the originator and partner agree cures or exclusions. Final acceptance of loans into a pool remains a credit and treasury decision.
integrations: Loan management system (via extract or API)
Document management system or SFTP for loan files
Co-lending platform or partner bank interface
guardrails: Every exception cites the document, page and rule that produced it
Eligibility rules version-controlled and approved by both partners
Tolerances for amounts and dates agreed in advance
Borrower data processed in the agreed environment with access logs
No loan marked clean while any mandatory document is unreadable
compliance_notes: Supports the due diligence each partner must perform under RBI's co-lending framework and its directions on transfer of loan exposures.
Helps evidence that Key Fact Statements and disclosures are present on digital loans, as RBI's digital lending rules expect.

pilot.scope: One recent co-lending tranche or assignment pool of manageable size, audited in full and compared with the sample-based review that was actually performed.
deliverables: Eligibility rules and checklist encoded for the pilot pool
Full-pool audit run with per-loan results
Comparison with the original sample review
Plan for running audits before each future tranche

what_we_measure.how: Sanction and agreement terms compared with reviewer-verified values on a sample.
Raised exceptions that reviewers confirmed as genuine, by exception type.
Issues found in the full-pool audit that the original sample review did not cover.
Elapsed time from pool receipt to exception report, compared with the current process.

faqs.q: Who uses this, the NBFC or the bank?
faqs.a: Either. Originators use it to clean pools before offering them, and partner banks or investors use it for their own due diligence. Both sides can share the same evidence pack if they agree to.

faqs.q: Can it handle pools of thousands of loans?
faqs.a: Yes. Processing scales with infrastructure, so full-pool review is practical where manual review would rely on sampling. The pilot measures throughput on your actual files.

faqs.q: How are our agreement's criteria encoded?
faqs.a: We translate each criterion into a rule, review the rule set with your credit and legal teams and version it. Criteria that need judgement go to reviewers rather than being forced into a rule.

faqs.q: What if documents are poor-quality scans?
faqs.a: Unreadable or low-confidence documents are listed as exceptions and never assumed to be fine. The report shows which files need rescanning.
